conclusion.root_cause: The burst block in CashInService.cashIn does not restrict bursts to milestones. The condition `if burstInfo and (milestone or gate(lastBurstAt, player))` lets ordinary cubes burst too, throttled to one per 0.15s. Milestones are also broadened beyond counts 1/10/50/100 by the cash-threshold milestones (50, 100, 500, ...). In my probe, 101 cash-ins spaced one frame apart produced 11 GameAssets.burst calls instead of 1-4, so ordinary cubes do burst. The burst is also gated on `burstInfo` (the collector lookup result). If no collector is found, as in the check's environment, there are 0 calls, even for milestone counts. That would explain the check's 0 observed calls, but I did not probe the no-collector case, so it is unconfirmed.
conclusion.evidence: Spying on GameAssets.burst during 101 CashInService.cashIn calls at Vector3(0,5,0) with 6 collector parts present gave burstCalls=11. Only 1, 10, 50 and 100 should fire. The code read from the Source shows `if burstInfo and (milestone or gate(lastBurstAt, player))`, which lets throttled ordinary cubes burst. It also shows `GameAssets.burst(burstInfo.part.Position)` being called with no collector fallback.
conclusion.fix_hint: Make the burst milestone-only: change the condition to `if milestone then`, and drop the gate/lastBurstAt path for ordinary cubes. Define the milestone for the burst only by count (MILESTONES[total]), not by the cash-threshold flag. Resolve the burst position as `if info then info.part.Position else pos` so the burst fires even when no collector is found.

function RebirthConfig.costFor(rebirths: number): number
	local n = math.max(0, math.floor(rebirths))

-- Permanent cash multiplier for a given number of rebirths.
function RebirthConfig.multiplierFor(rebirths: number): number
	local n = math.max(0, math.floor(rebirths))
	return 1 + RebirthConfig.multPerRebirth * n
end

-- Formats a multiplier for display, e.g. 1.5 -> "1.5", 2 -> "2.0".
function RebirthConfig.formatMultiplier(mult: number): string
	return string.format("%.1f", mult)

function RebirthConfig.bannerText(rebirths: number): string
	return "REBIRTH x" .. RebirthConfig.formatMultiplier(RebirthConfig.multiplierFor(rebirths)) .. "!"
end

function RebirthConfig.applyMultiplier(value: number, rebirths: number): number
	return math.floor(value * RebirthConfig.multiplierFor(rebirths) + 0.5)
end

function RebirthConfig.canRebirth(cash: number, rebirths: number, allUpgradesBought: boolean): boolean
	return allUpgradesBought or cash >= RebirthConfig.costFor(rebirths)
end

--!strict
-- RebirthConfig: shared tunables and pure helpers for the Rebirth feature (server and client).

local RebirthConfig = {
	baseCost = 5000,
	costGrowth = 2,
	multPerRebirth = 0.5,
	requestCooldown = 1.5, -- seconds between rebirth requests per player
	altarColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 40),
	altarGlowColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 150),
	altarSize = Vector3.new(4, 5, 4),
	flashDuration = 1.2, -- seconds for the full-screen golden flash
	bannerDuration = 2.5, -- seconds the 'REBIRTH x<mult>!' banner stays up
	flashColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 60),
}

-- Cash required for the next rebirth, given how many rebirths were already done.
function RebirthConfig.costFor(rebirths: number): number
	local n = math.max(0, math.floor(rebirths))
	return math.floor(RebirthConfig.baseCost * RebirthConfig.costGrowth ^ n)
end

-- Permanent cash multiplier for a given number of rebirths.
function RebirthConfig.multiplierFor(rebirths: number): number
	local n = math.max(0, math.floor(rebirths))
	return 1 + RebirthConfig.multPerRebirth * n
end

-- Formats a multiplier for display, e.g. 1.5 -> "1.5", 2 -> "2.0".
function RebirthConfig.formatMultiplier(mult: number): string
	return string.format("%.1f", mult)
end

-- Banner text, e.g. "REBIRTH x1.5!".
function RebirthConfig.bannerText(rebirths: number): string
	return "REBIRTH x" .. RebirthConfig.formatMultiplier(RebirthConfig.multiplierFor(rebirths)) .. "!"
end

-- Rounded payout for a cube value after applying the multiplier.
function RebirthConfig.applyMultiplier(value: number, rebirths: number): number
	return math.floor(value * RebirthConfig.multiplierFor(rebirths) + 0.5)
end

-- Whether a player may rebirth: enough cash, or every upgrade bought.
function RebirthConfig.canRebirth(cash: number, rebirths: number, allUpgradesBought: boolean): boolean
	return allUpgradesBought or cash >= RebirthConfig.costFor(rebirths)
end

return RebirthConfig

local function setupPlayer(player: Player)
	if totals[player] ~= nil then

	totals[player] = 0
	player:SetAttribute("TotalEarned", 0)

	local stats = player:WaitForChild("leaderstats", WAIT_TIMEOUT)
	if player.Parent == nil then
		return
	end
	if not stats then
		local f = Instance.new("Folder")
		f.Name = "leaderstats"
		f.Parent = player
		stats = f
	end
	local s = stats :: Instance
	s:WaitForChild("Cash", WAIT_TIMEOUT)
	s:WaitForChild("Rebirths", WAIT_TIMEOUT)
	if player.Parent == nil then
		return
	end
	local cash = ensureValue(s, "Cash")
	ensureValue(s, "Rebirths")

	local last = cash.Value
	conns[player] = cash.Changed:Connect(function(newValue)
		local delta = newValue - last
		last = newValue
		if delta > 0 and totals[player] ~= nil then
			totals[player] += delta
			player:SetAttribute("TotalEarned", totals[player])
		end
	end)
end
